name: Druva - Rare Administrator Login
description: Detects administrator/IP/location combinations observed no more than twice within the baseline window and explains why the login is considered rare.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects administrator/IP/location combinations observed no more than twice within the baseline window and explains why the login is considered rare.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(source.ip),
      "Unknown"
    )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL login_hour =
    DATE_EXTRACT(
      "hour_of_day",
      event_time
    )

| EVAL outside_hours =
    login_hour < 7
    OR login_hour >= 19

| WHERE admin IS NOT NULL
    AND login_ip IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    occurrence_count = COUNT(*),

    first_seen =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_seen =
      MAX(event_time),

    login_hours =
      VALUES(login_hour),

    outside_hours_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE outside_hours,

    representative_event_type =
      FIRST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    representative_event_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      )

  BY admin, login_ip, location

| WHERE occurrence_count <= 2

| EVAL rarity_reason = CASE(
    occurrence_count == 1
      AND outside_hours_count > 0,
      "First observed IP/location + outside normal hours",

    occurrence_count == 1,
      "First observed IP/location",

    occurrence_count == 2
      AND outside_hours_count > 0,
      "Rare IP/location + outside normal hours",

    "Rare IP/location combination"
  )

name: Druva - Backup Success Rate Drop
description: Detects a low ratio of successful backup-related events compared with failures during the observation window.
author: Druva

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 2 – Backup Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a low ratio of successful backup-related events compared with failures during the observation window.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL state = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(event.outcome), TO_STRING(event.outcome), ""))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| WHERE event_text LIKE "*backup*"
| EVAL is_failure = event_text LIKE "*failed*" OR state == "failure"
| EVAL is_success = event_text LIKE "*success*" OR state == "success"
| WHERE is_failure OR is_success
| STATS
    success_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_success,
    failure_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_failure,
    first_seen = MIN(event_time),
    last_seen = MAX(event_time)
| EVAL total_count = success_count + failure_count
| EVAL failure_percent = ROUND(100.0 * failure_count / total_count, 1)
| WHERE total_count >= 10 AND failure_percent >= 50

name: Druva - Short-Lived Administrator Account
description: Detects an administrator account that is created and subsequently deleted within 24 hours. Highlights potentially temporary or covert privileged access.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator account that is created and subsequently deleted within 24 hours. Highlights potentially temporary or covert privileged access.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Administrator Created"
    OR druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted"

| EVAL target_admin =
    TO_STRING(user.email)

| EVAL actor =
    TO_STRING(user.id)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL action = CASE(
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Created", "created",
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted", "deleted",
    "other"
  )

| WHERE target_admin IS NOT NULL
    AND action != "other"

| STATS
    created_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "deleted",

    created_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "deleted"

  BY target_admin

| WHERE creation_count > 0
    AND deletion_count > 0
    AND deleted_at >= created_at

| EVAL lifetime_minutes =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      created_at,
      deleted_at
    )

| WHERE lifetime_minutes <= 1440

name: Druva - Unusual Data Activity Followed by Quarantine
description: Correlates unusual data activity with subsequent quarantine of the same protected resource.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Correlates unusual data activity with subsequent quarantine of the same protected resource.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*data anomaly*"

| EVAL is_quarantine =
    event_text LIKE "*quarantine*"
    OR druva.event_type == "Added To Quarantine Bay"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (is_uda OR is_quarantine)

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_quarantine,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_quarantine =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_actions =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_quarantine

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND quarantine_count > 0
    AND first_quarantine >= first_uda

| EVAL minutes_to_quarantine =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_quarantine
    )

    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),

name: Druva - Privileged Action Immediately After Login
description: Detects an administrator login followed closely by privileged Druva administrative activity from the same administrator. This sequence can indicate rapid post-authentication abuse of a compromised account.
author: Druva

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 1 – Administrator & Identity
meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator login followed closely by privileged Druva administrative activity from the same administrator. This sequence can indicate rapid post-authentication abuse of a compromised account.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )
| EVAL is_login = druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
| EVAL is_privileged_action = druva.event_type != "Admin Login"
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL AND (is_login OR is_privileged_action)
| STATS
    login_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_login,
    privileged_action_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    login_time = MAX(event_time) WHERE is_login,
    first_privileged_action = MIN(event_time) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    actions = VALUES(druva.event_type) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    login_ips = VALUES(TO_STRING(source.ip)) WHERE is_login
  BY actor
| WHERE login_count > 0
    AND privileged_action_count > 0
    AND first_privileged_action >= login_time
| EVAL minutes_to_action = DATE_DIFF("minutes", login_time, first_privileged_action)
| WHERE minutes_to_action <= 5

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects resources experiencing unusual data activity and backup failures within the same observation window, potentially indicating an attack affecting recoverability.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL status_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL feature_text =
    TO_LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        TO_STRING(druva.feature),
        ""
      )
    )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_failure =
    (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*"
      OR feature_text LIKE "*backup*"
    )
    AND (
      status_text LIKE "*fail*"
      OR status_text LIKE "*error*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*failed*"
    )

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      is_uda
      OR is_backup_failure
    )

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_failure,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_backup_failure =
      MIN(event_time)
        WHERE is_backup_failure,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_backup_failure,

    first_uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    first_failure_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_failure

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND backup_failure_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_backup_failure
    )

tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a large number of modified, deleted, or encrypted files associated with a Druva resource.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE
    druva.file.deleted_count IS NOT NULL
    OR druva.file.updated_count IS NOT NULL
    OR druva.file.encrypted_count IS NOT NULL

| EVAL resource =
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)

| EVAL deleted =
    COALESCE(
      TO_LONG(druva.file.deleted_count),
      TO_LONG(0)
    )

| EVAL updated =
    COALESCE(
      TO_LONG(druva.file.updated_count),
      TO_LONG(0)
    )

| EVAL encrypted =
    COALESCE(
      TO_LONG(druva.file.encrypted_count),
      TO_LONG(0)
    )

| EVAL new_files =
    COALESCE(
      TO_LONG(druva.file.created_count),
      TO_LONG(0)
    )

| EVAL suspicious_changes =
    deleted + updated + encrypted

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE suspicious_changes >= 10000

name: Druva - UDA Correlated With Backup Disablement
description: Detects unusual data activity combined with backup disablement or pause for the same resource, indicating a potentially serious attempt to compromise data and recovery simultaneously.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects unusual data activity combined with backup disablement or pause for the same resource, indicating a potentially serious attempt to compromise data and recovery simultaneously.

query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_disabled =
    event_text LIKE "*backup*disabled*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*disabled*backup*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*backup*paused*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*paused*backup*"

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      is_uda
      OR is_backup_disabled
    )

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_disable =
      MIN(event_time)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    disable_actors =
      VALUES(actor)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_disabled

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND disable_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_disable
    )
